headline: Amazon is changing who runs its Alexa voice assistant business a day after announcing its first Alexa tablets.
score_reason: Confirmed executive change, but Amazon gave no reason and the effect on products is unknown.
importance_line: Changes who leads the voice assistant that Amazon is rebuilding with generative AI, which matters to people who use Alexa and to Amazon's devices team; Amazon declined to give more detail, so the reason for the change is not stated.
summary: Reuters reports that Amazon confirmed on Friday that Daniel Rausch, a 17-year veteran who has led Alexa and Echo for over three years, is leaving the unit next month and will return in another role in its devices and services division in 2027. Aidan Marcuss, now vice president of Fire TV, advertising and the Amazon appstore, takes over, while Kevin Keith keeps his product and marketing role and temporarily adds Marcuss' former duties.
notes: Original Reuters page blocked (401); text read on The Economic Times copy of the Reuters story.
